english.note: Use this when caring about someone or something means showing concern for their welfare or feelings.
Use this all-purpose verb when someone cares about a person or their welfare.

examples.english: I really care about your feelings.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 gwaan1 sam1 nei5 ge3 gam2 sau6

examples.english: I concern myself with my mum's health every day.
examples.traditional: 我每日都關心阿媽嘅健康。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 gwaan1 sam1 aa3 maa1 ge3 gin6 hong1
